items.headline: Israeli strike on Gaza food-aid van kills three
items.summary: The van was carrying food rations to displaced people west of Gaza City; separately, a man was shot dead by Israeli forces in Jabalia.

items.headline: Iran says it shot down US drones over Hormuz
items.summary: Efforts to end the war remain stalled, and the US placed sanctions on four Iranians it says acted as 'oil trustees'.

items.headline: Russian strike kills two and wounds 60 in Zelenskyy's hometown
items.summary: The attack hit Kryvyi Rih, the Ukrainian president's home city, as peace efforts continue.

items.headline: UK and EU agree steps to improve trade ties
items.summary: The new arrangements could cut costs for food exporters and shield British industry from EU carbon border charges.

items.headline: Record 738,144 UK firms in significant financial distress
items.summary: Higher borrowing, staff and energy costs are piling pressure on businesses, even as October retail sales bounced back.

items.headline: Nasdaq wipes out all its 2026 gains in AI sell-off
items.summary: The slide also weighed on Anthropic's second day of trading.

items.headline: SEC reportedly examining possible accounting issues at Nvidia
items.summary: Nvidia's losses doubled after Reuters reported the probe, capping a seventh straight weekly fall, its longest losing run since 2008.

items.headline: Mathematician says Claude helped produce a Riemann Hypothesis proof
items.summary: An Anthropic mathematician made the claim, and a Stanford researcher said he independently reached the same result. Independent experts have yet to confirm it.

items.headline: Researcher finds AI providers leaking users' prompts
items.summary: Dragos's HD Moore sent nearly two million bait prompts and found at least three AI providers breached, plus resellers logging prompts.
